profile.headline: Bearing skills on new project!
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer
•	More than 10 years of senior software engineering experience, with strong analytical skills and a broad range of computer expertise.
•	An excellent problem-solver, able to quickly grasp complex systems and identify opportunities for improvements and resolution of critical issues.
•	An effective leader, skilled in enlisting the support of all team members in aligning with project and organizational goals.
•	Full SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) experience.


Specialties: application development,  billing,  brio,  business intelligence,  c/c++,  client/server,  cognos impromptu,  conversion,  customer relations,  html,  ibm db/2,  inventory management,  iso 9000,  java,  JSP,  javascript,  jdbc,  logistics,  mis,  netscape enterprise server,  oracle,  oracle pl/sql,  oracle sql,  powerbuilder,  presentation skills,  process engineering,  ras,  rdbms,  real time,  requirements,  software architecture,  software development,  sql,  sqr,  sybase,  unix, xml, Point of Sale

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Assisted in the transfer of Infosystems supporting DirectTV to Cognizant. Responsible for the VPM flow, installed and set up local environment for coding duties.
•	Executed standard software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting.
•	Set the overall guidance and expectations for team output, practices, and collaboration.
•	Developed secure and high-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code written by others.
•	Worked Agile (Scrum or Kanban) team environment. 
•	Oversaw design and delivery of high-quality features that comply with standards.
•	Mentored others on coding standards and performed code reviews.
•	Provided on-call support, monitored the system, and identified system deficiencies.
•	Participated in Architecture and Engineering code and design reviews.
•	Created and executed automated test plans/strategies utilizing business requirements and collaborating with engineers/architects and clients to validate test environments, test data.
•	Direct experience in AWS, Microservices, RESTful Web Services development in Java (Spring Boot)
•	Supported DevOps
positions.insights: Skills: Shell Scripting · Java · Programming · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: C++ Developer
positions.description:
C++ Developer {C/C++, Java, Visual Studio, Jira, POS development, Modernization Activities}
Facilitated with development of Sam's Club POS SMART system in conjunction to the Walmart POS team. These are high priority applications that help with the inefficiency of their current legacy platform while also migrating them to their new platform on Azure. Initiative-taking and reaching out to other groups if in need of help. Ultimately worked on Sam's Club Member Checkout while upgrading their Cloud Powered Checkout system.
•	Linked legacy registers to online orders to allow customers to pay at registers.
•	C++ (pointers, memory managment, inheritance, polymorphism, and Object-Oriented Programming)
•	4690 OS 
•	POS Azure
•	Microservices
•	PCI DSS
positions.insights: Skills: Shell Scripting · Programming · C/C++ · POS · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Linux

The support engineers in this competency are responsible in assisting customers with the Installation, Maintenance and Administration of Oracle Applications. Overall qualifications and skills:

•	Administrating one or more of the following technologies: Database administration and Patching, Application Server, JDeveloper or other IDE Java tools , E-business Suite, Oracle Business Intelligence Publisher or Enterprise manager would be an advantage.(DBA, RDBMS, Sys/System Admin, Network Admin, HelpDesk, Developer)
•	Knowledge of Operating Systems (UNIX, Linux, Windows or other relevant OS-system), SQL, PLSQL
•	Knowledge of Java, XML, Perl, Oracle Developer (Forms/Reports), SOA, Database/Application Performance Tuning.

o	Investigated and corrected promotions that were stuck or lost.
o	Corrected and deployed price fixes for system and individual stores.

positions.description:
Sr. Programmer/Analyst  Assignment with HP (C/C++, SQL, UNIX, VMware, HPALM)
•	Converted Wisconsin Managed Care health system to Arkansas Manage Care Health System
o	Created new physician reports for Arkansas
o	Modified existing code to meet Arkansas requirements
o	Deleted code that was no longer needed

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Sr. Programmer/Analyst Point of Sale development
•	Initiated and led the design and implementation of several POS/Payment system projects:
o	Consulted with Project Manager, offering technical and resource planning expertise to ensure optimal design and implementation of new system.
o	Created analysis and design documents and coordinated development, database services, testing, deployment, documentation and training.
o	Collaborated with internal and external users to determine requirements and negotiated with stakeholders to resolve conflicting system needs.
•	Projects deployed and installed to more than 8,000 retail units under 59 different banners in 15 countries. .
positions.insights: Skills: Shell Scripting · Programming · C/C++ · POS · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Linux

positions.title: Sr. Developer
positions.description:
Worked in critical real time 24/7 heterogeneous system environment supporting: train dispatcher applications, diagnostic/dynamic report tools, clerk fax retrieval system, and others using C/C++, Java, Powerbuilder, Sybase, DB2, Oracle, Unix, and Windows.; Duties included bug/ticket fixes and project enhancement work.
Lead Java developer for Abols enhancement to remove legacy email interface, and replace it with robust sftp module for automatic delevery to abols clerks. 
Automated on demand report to automatically generate report monthly for Demurrage and Miscellaneos Billing Exception using java and jcron.  
Converted hundreds Brio reports to new NSBI (Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition).  After conversion, became sole support for remaining Brio8 issues.
positions.insights: Skills: Logistics · Shell Scripting · Programming · C/C++ · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Linux

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the maintenance and operation of the USMC legacy logistics system (MCDSS); system tracked millions of dollars of military war assets from depot to deployment. 
Researched, resolved and deployed solutions for client's defects. 
Designed, developed and implemented custom client side COGNOS reports. 
Developed client side interface according to requirements and standards as well as dynamic queries to provide statistical information.
positions.insights: Skills: Shell Scripting · Java · Military Logistics · Programming · C/C++ · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Linux

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Performed application development and maintenance using C, Capture, UNIX, Java, JDBC, XML, Oracle, PL/SQL. Devised, developed, implemented, and tested innovative software solutions (SFDM and SCE) for the software development test division. 
Using in-depth knowledge of software architecture, development methodologies, and engineering practices I consulted with business specialists and project managers to understand a problem and generate requirement specifications. 
Defined architecture of solution, produced detailed design specifications, and implemented solutions.
Environment: Capture, C/C++, Java, Javascript, JSP, HTML, XML, Windows, Unix, Oracle SQL
positions.insights: Skills: Shell Scripting · Programming · C/C++ · Linux
